macos: xcode-select --install   (Xcode or the Command Line Tools; the Metal compiler must be reachable through xcrun)
uv venv build-tools && uv pip install --python build-tools/bin/python cmake ninja   (or brew install cmake ninja)
scripts/build_metal.sh --build-type Release --model-set custom --models MODELS --target audiocpp_server   (MODELS: cosyvoice3 or fish_audio or fish_drama3; several separated by commas)
the server is build/macos-metal-release/bin/audiocpp_server; then: export FOLIVOX_NATIVE_SERVER=<that file>
linux-cuda: GCC 13+, CMake, CUDA Toolkit 12+ (the toolkit's own nvcc, not the distro's)
cmake --build build -j --target audiocpp_server   (check: readelf -d build/bin/audiocpp_server | grep NEEDED | grep cuda shows libcudart.so.12)
windows-cuda: Visual Studio Build Tools 2022 (C++ workload), CMake, Ninja, the CUDA Toolkit, Git
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\build_windows.ps1 -Preset windows-cuda-release -ModelSet custom -Models MODELS -Target audiocpp_server
the server is build\windows-cuda-release\bin\audiocpp_server.exe; then: setx FOLIVOX_NATIVE_SERVER <that file>
windows-vulkan: Visual Studio Build Tools 2022, CMake, Ninja, the LunarG Vulkan SDK (glslc), Git
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\build_windows.ps1 -Preset windows-vulkan-release -ModelSet custom -Models MODELS -Target audiocpp_server
amd-hip: AMD GPUs on Windows: community packages with the ROCm runtime built in are published at https://github.com/IIIIIllllIIIIIlllll/audio.cpp/releases (not checked by Folivox); on Linux see docs/build/HIP.md in the audio.cpp repository

drama3.note: Drama 3 was merged into upstream audio.cpp main on 2026-10-16, after release v0.9.2: there are no release binaries yet, so it is built from this pinned commit. Replace by the release binaries once a release contains it.
